feature: Gap caliper under a row label
summary: A Gap caliper dropped in the space between two cards now keeps its number off the row label above it. Before, measuring under the words of a row lost that row and the number climbed onto the text. Size mode hover benefits too: elements are found under their own labels and icons where they used to be missed.
setup: Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next. Open the settings-pane capture from the measure audits (Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/Fixtures/settings-pane-2x.png).

try.do: Press M for Measure and pick Gap mode.
Click in the space between the two settings cards, directly under the words Play sound on capture.
Click the same space again further right, over the blank part of the row.
Switch to Size mode and hover over the left end of a row, across its icon and label.

evaluate: Does the number under the label sit in the gap, clear of the text, the same way it does over the blank part of the row?
In Size mode, does the row light up as one element all along its width, including over its icon and label?
Does hovering feel as quick as before?
rough: In this 33 px gap the 44 px pill still overhangs both card edges by about 5 px a side. That is the separate boxed-in decision already open, not this fix.
Verified on the fixture capture through the real renderer and a sweep along the whole gap. Not tried live in the app: the unmanned loop cannot drive the pointer.
